_comment: Copy to watchlist.json and fill in real handles. The RYO MCP URL and key are already confirmed (see .env) -- this file only needs real source handles. Each entry is one token: which sources to pull evidence from, and which RYO tools to pull facts from. fact_tools defaults to analyze_token, deep_analysis if omitted -- those are two of the six tools on the real catalog; check_safety and supported_tokens are not on it and calling them will fail.
